spans.s: Nṛga, an ancient king. § 61 (Sarpasattra): I, 55, †2101 (ºsya yajñaḥ, comparison).--§ 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 319 (in the palace of Yama).--§ 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 88, 8329 (sarin Nºsya, i.e. Payoshṇī), 8330 (Mārkaṇḍeya sung a gāthā in honour of N.), 8331 (performed a sacrifice, at the tīrtha Vārāha on the Payoshṇī).--§ 378 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 94, 8503 (yathaiva hi Nºo rājā).--§ 403b (Payoshṇī): III, 121, 10291 (description of N's sacrifice on the Payoshṇī). --§ 468 (Indradyumnop.): III, 199, ††13348 (nanu Devakīputreṇāpi Kṛshṇena Narake majjamāno rājarshir Nºs tasmāt kṛcchrāt punaḥ samuddhṛtya svargaṃ prāpitaḥ. cf. § 746).-§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 315.--§ 576 (Bhagavadgītāp.): VI, 17, 645 (obtaine the highest regions).--§ 595 (Shoḍaśarāj., v. Māndhātṛ): VIII, 62, 2282 (vanquished by Māndhātṛ).--§ 615kk (Kurukshetrak.): IX, 53, †3031 (ºādyā naradevamukhyāḥ, performed sacrifices in Kurukshetra). --§ 621 (Rājadh.): XII, 8, 238 (had ruled the earth).-§ 720b (Sudarśanop.): XIII, 2, 121 (grandson of Oghavat). --§ 723 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 6, 332 (had been transformed into a lizard (kṛkalāsa, cf. § 746).--§ 746 (do.): XIII, 70, 3452 (ºena sumahat kṛeekraṃ yad avāptaṃ), 3458, 3461, 3481, 3482, 3483 (on account of his giving away a cow who did not belong to him N. was reborn as a lizard (kṛkalāsa) but was rescued by Kṛshṇa); 72, 3453 (all. to chap. 70); 76, †3689 (had made-gifts of kine)--§ 747 (do.): XIII, 84, 3934 (do.).--§ 761 (do.): XIII, 115, 5662 (abstained from meat during the month of Kārttika).--§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7674 (enumeration).--§ 786d (Nakulākhyāna): King N. made gifts of thousands of cows to the twice born, by giving away only one cow which did not belong to him he fell into hell: XIV, 90, 2789.
